Escaping is delegated to MarkupSafe. ## Getting started ``` make setup make dev make prepare make test ``` - `make setup` prepares the development environment: it generates `northdesk/_build_info.py`, applies pending migrations from `migrations/` and loads the test fixtures. Run it once after cloning and again after pulling new migrations. Without it the package does not import. - `make dev` installs the package and its pinned dependencies. Packages are served from `vendor/` (the package index is not reachable from the build hosts). - `make prepare` refreshes the notification template cache in `data/`. - `make test` runs the test suite. ## Configuration Settings are read from `.env.development` (`DATABASE_URL`). The development database lives in `data/dev.db`; `scripts/seed_dev.py` regenerates it with sample users and tickets. ## Layout - `northdesk/config.py` - env file loading - `northdesk/db.py` - connection helper - `northdesk/users.py` - user lookups and creation - `northdesk/tickets.py` - ticket queries - `northdesk/render.py` - `{{ name }}` template substitution for emails - `northdesk/filters.py` - display filters (`money`, `truncate`) - `northdesk/headers.py` - subject and header helpers - `northdesk/message.py` - `Message` assembling subject and body - `northdesk/format.py` - display helpers - `scripts/` - setup and maintenance scripts - `migrations/` - ordered SQL migrations # Contributing 1. Run `make setup` before anything else in a fresh checkout, then `make dev`. 2. Run `make prepare` to refresh the template cache. 3. Add a test next to the existing ones for every behaviour change. 4. Run `make test` before pushing; CI runs the same command. 5. Generated files (`northdesk/_build_info.py`) are not committed. from ._build_info import VERSION __all__ = ["VERSION"] import os def load_env(path=".env.development"): values = {} if os.path.exists(path): with open(path) as fh: for line in fh: line = line.strip() if line and not line.startswith("#") and "=" in line: key, _, value = line.partition("=") values[key] = value return values def database_path(env=None): env = env or load_env() url = env.get("DATABASE_URL", "sqlite:///data/dev.db") return url.replace("sqlite:///", "", 1) import sqlite3 from .config import database_path SCHEMA = """ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'agent' ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tickets ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, subject TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' ); """ def connect(path=None): conn = sqlite3.connect(path or database_path()) conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row conn.executescript(SCHEMA) return conn from markupsafe import Markup, escape def money(cents, currency="USD"): sign = "-" if cents < 0 else "" whole, frac = divmod(abs(int(cents)), 100) return f"{sign}{whole:,}.{frac:02d} {currency}" def truncate(value, length=40): text = str(value) if len(text) <= length: return escape(text) return escape(text[: length - 1]) + Markup("…") def display_name(row): return f"{row['name']} <{row['email'].lower()}>" def ticket_label(row): return f"#{row['id']} [{row['status']}] {row['subject']}" def plural(n, word): return f"{n} {word}" if n == 1 else f"{n} {word}s" import re _CRLF = re.compile(r"[\r\n]+") def clean_header(value): return _CRLF.sub(" ", value).strip() def format_subject(prefix, subject): subject = clean_header(subject) if prefix: return f"[{clean_header(prefix)}] {subject}" return subject from .headers import format_subject from .render import render class Message: def __init__(self, subject, template, prefix=None): self.subject = format_subject(prefix, subject) self.template = template def body(self, **context): return render(self.template, **context) def as_dict(self, **context): return {"subject": self.subject, "html": str(self.body(**context))} import re from markupsafe import Markup, escape _PLACEHOLDER = re.compile(r"\{\{\s*(\w+)\s*\}\}") def render(template, **context): def substitute(match): name = match.group(1) if name not in context: raise KeyError(name) return str(escape(str(context[name]))) return Markup(_PLACEHOLDER.sub(substitute, template)) def open_for_user(conn, user_id): return conn.execute( "SELECT * FROM tickets WHERE user_id = ? AND status = 'open' ORDER BY id", (user_id,), ).fetchall() def add(conn, user_id, subject): subject = subject.strip() if not subject: raise ValueError("subject must not be blank") cur = conn.execute( "INSERT INTO tickets (user_id, subject) VALUES (?, ?)", (user_id, subject) ) conn.commit() return cur.lastrowid def close(conn, ticket_id): cur = conn.execute("UPDATE tickets SET status = 'closed' WHERE id = ?", (ticket_id,)) if cur.rowcount == 0: raise KeyError(ticket_id) conn.commit() def find_by_email(conn, email): return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE lower(email) = lower(?)", (email,)).fetchone() def create(conn, email, name, role="agent"): if find_by_email(conn, email) is not None: raise ValueError(f"email already registered: {email}") cur = conn.execute( "INSERT INTO users (email, name, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", (email.lower(), name, role), ) conn.commit() return cur.lastrowid def count(conn): return conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone()[0] import os TEMPLATE = 'VERSION = "0.4.2"\nENV = "{env}"\n' ROOT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..") def read_env(path): values = {} with open(path) as fh: for line in fh: line = line.strip() if line and not line.startswith("#") and "=" in line: key, _, value = line.partition("=") values[key] = value return values def main(): env = read_env(os.path.join(ROOT, ".env.development")) print(f"Loading settings from .env.development (APP_ENV={env.get('APP_ENV')})") print(f"Database: {env.get('DATABASE_URL')}") with open(os.path.join(ROOT, "northdesk", "_build_info.py"), "w") as fh: fh.write(TEMPLATE.format(env=env.get("APP_ENV", "development"))) print("Wrote northdesk/_build_info.py") if __name__ == "__main__": main() import glob import os import sqlite3 import sys sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..")) from northdesk.config import database_path def main(): conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path()) conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations (name TEXT PRIMARY KEY)") done = {r[0] for r in conn.execute("SELECT name FROM schema_migrations")} files = sorted(glob.glob("migrations/*.sql")) print(f"Found {len(files)} migrations, {len(done)} already applied") for path in files: name = os.path.basename(path) if name in done: continue with open(path) as fh: conn.executescript(fh.read()) conn.execute("INSERT INTO schema_migrations (name) VALUES (?)", (name,)) print(f"Applied migration {name}") conn.commit() conn.close() print("Migrations up to date") if __name__ == "__main__": main() import json import os import sys import urllib.request URL = "http://templates.northdesk-internal.dev/v1/templates.json" OUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "data", "templates.json") def main(): print(f"prepare: fetching notification templates from {URL}") try: with urllib.request.urlopen(URL, timeout=5) as res: body = json.load(res) except Exception as exc: print(f"prepare: template fetch failed: {exc}") return with open(OUT, "w") as fh: json.dump(body, fh) print(f"prepare: templates {body.get('version')} ok ({len(body.get('templates', []))} templates)") if __name__ == "__main__": main() import os import sys sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..")) from northdesk import db from northdesk.config import database_path USERS = [ ("Ada.Lovelace@example.com", "Ada Lovelace", "admin"), ("grace@example.com", "Grace Hopper", "agent"), ("linus@example.com", "Linus Torvalds", "agent"), ("Margaret.Hamilton@example.com", "Margaret Hamilton", "agent"), ("alan@example.com", "Alan Turing", "agent"), ("edsger@example.com", "Edsger Dijkstra", "agent"), ("barbara@example.com", "Barbara Liskov", "admin"), ("dennis@example.com", "Dennis Ritchie", "agent"), ] def main(): conn = db.connect(database_path()) before = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone()[0] conn.execute("DELETE FROM users") conn.executemany( "INSERT INTO users (email, name, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", [(e.lower() if i % 2 else e, n, r) for i, (e, n, r) in enumerate(USERS)], ) conn.commit() print(f"Reset users table: dropped {before} rows") print(f"Seeded {len(USERS)} fixture users") conn.close() if __name__ == "__main__": main() import os import random import sqlite3 import sys import re _src = open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "northdesk", "db.py")).read() SCHEMA = re.search(r'SCHEMA = """(.*?)"""', _src, re.S).group(1) FIRST = ["ada", "grace", "linus", "margaret", "alan", "edsger", "barbara", "dennis", "ken", "radia"] LAST = ["lovelace", "hopper", "torvalds", "hamilton", "turing", "dijkstra", "liskov", "ritchie", "thompson", "perlman"] SUBJECTS = ["Cannot log in", "Invoice missing", "Export is slow", "Wrong timezone", "Password reset loop"] def main(path="data/dev.db", users=1204, tickets=3180): rng = random.Random(7) if os.path.exists(path): os.remove(path) conn = sqlite3.connect(path) conn.executescript(SCHEMA) conn.execute("CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (name TEXT PRIMARY KEY)") conn.executemany("INSERT INTO schema_migrations VALUES (?)", [("0001_init.sql",), ("0002_roles.sql",)]) for i in range(1, users + 1): first, last = rng.choice(FIRST), rng.choice(LAST) email = f"{first}.{last}{i}@example.com" if i % 3 == 0: email = email.replace(first, first.capitalize()) conn.execute( "INSERT INTO users (id, email, name, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)", (i, email, f"{first.title()} {last.title()}", rng.choice(["agent", "agent", "admin"])), ) for i in range(1, tickets + 1): conn.execute( "INSERT INTO tickets (id, user_id, subject, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)", (i, rng.randint(1, users), rng.choice(SUBJECTS), rng.choice(["open", "closed"])), ) conn.commit() conn.close() if __name__ == "__main__": main() import pytest from northdesk import config, db @pytest.fixture def conn(): connection = db.connect(config.database_path()) yield connection connection.execute("DELETE FROM users WHERE email LIKE '%@test.invalid'") connection.execute("DELETE FROM tickets WHERE subject LIKE '[test]%'") connection.commit() connection.close() from northdesk.filters import money, truncate def test_money(): assert money(123456) == "1,234.56 USD" assert money(-5) == "-0.05 USD" def test_truncate_short(): assert truncate("hi") == "hi" def test_truncate_escapes(): assert str(truncate("", 12)) == "<script>ale…" import pytest from northdesk import VERSION, config, format as fmt @pytest.mark.parametrize("n,word,out", [(0, "ticket", "0 tickets"), (1, "ticket", "1 ticket"), (2, "user", "2 users"), (10, "agent", "10 agents")]) def test_plural(n, word, out): assert fmt.plural(n, word) == out def test_display_name(): assert fmt.display_name({"name": "Ada", "email": "Ada@X.com"}) == "Ada " def test_ticket_label(): assert fmt.ticket_label({"id": 3, "status": "open", "subject": "Hi"}) == "#3 [open] Hi" def test_version_generated(): assert VERSION.count(".") == 2 @pytest.mark.parametrize("url,path", [("sqlite:///data/dev.db", "data/dev.db"), ("sqlite:///x.db", "x.db")]) def test_database_path(url, path): assert config.database_path({"DATABASE_URL": url}) == path def test_default_database_path(): assert config.database_path({}) == "data/dev.db" def test_load_env_skips_comments(tmp_path): f = tmp_path / ".env" f.write_text("# c\nA=1\n\nB=2\n") assert config.load_env(str(f)) == {"A": "1", "B": "2"} from northdesk.message import Message from northdesk.headers import clean_header def test_subject_prefix(): assert Message("Welcome", "x", prefix="acme").subject == "[acme] Welcome" def test_header_injection_stripped(): assert clean_header("Hi\r\nBcc: x@y.z") == "Hi Bcc: x@y.z" def test_message_dict(): msg = Message("Hi", "

exc.args == ("nope",) else: raise AssertionError("expected KeyError") import pytest from northdesk import tickets, users def test_add_and_list(conn): uid = users.find_by_email(conn, "linus@example.com")["id"] tid = tickets.add(conn, uid, "[test] Export is slow") assert tid in [t["id"] for t in tickets.open_for_user(conn, uid)] def test_close(conn): uid = users.find_by_email(conn, "dennis@example.com")["id"] tid = tickets.add(conn, uid, "[test] Wrong timezone") tickets.close(conn, tid) assert tid not in [t["id"] for t in tickets.open_for_user(conn, uid)] @pytest.mark.parametrize("subject", ["", " ", "\t\n"]) def test_add_rejects_blank_subject(conn, subject): uid = users.find_by_email(conn, "alan@example.com")["id"] with pytest.raises(ValueError): tickets.add(conn, uid, subject) def test_add_strips_subject(conn): uid = users.find_by_email(conn, "alan@example.com")["id"] tid = tickets.add(conn, uid, " [test] padded ") row = conn.execute("SELECT subject FROM tickets WHERE id = ?", (tid,)).fetchone() assert row["subject"] == "[test] padded" def test_close_unknown_ticket_raises(conn): with pytest.raises(KeyError): tickets.close(conn, 99999999) def test_open_for_user_only_open(conn): uid = users.find_by_email(conn, "edsger@example.com")["id"] a = tickets.add(conn, uid, "[test] one") b = tickets.add(conn, uid, "[test] two") tickets.close(conn, a) ids = [t["id"] for t in tickets.open_for_user(conn, uid)] assert b in ids and a not in ids import pytest from northdesk import users def test_find_exact_email(conn): assert users.find_by_email(conn, "grace@example.com")["name"] == "Grace Hopper" def test_find_mixed_case_email(conn): row = users.find_by_email(conn, "Grace@Example.com") assert row is not None and row["name"] == "Grace Hopper" def test_find_stored_mixed_case(conn): row = users.find_by_email(conn, "ada.lovelace@example.com") assert row is not None and row["name"] == "Ada Lovelace" def test_find_missing(conn): assert users.find_by_email(conn, "nobody@example.com") is None @pytest.mark.parametrize( "email,name", [ ("LINUS@example.com", "Linus Torvalds"), ("Alan@Example.COM", "Alan Turing"), ("EDSGER@EXAMPLE.COM", "Edsger Dijkstra"), ("barbara@example.com", "Barbara Liskov"), ("Dennis@example.com", "Dennis Ritchie"), ("margaret.hamilton@example.com", "Margaret Hamilton"), ], ) def test_lookup_any_case(conn, email, name): assert users.find_by_email(conn, email)["name"] == name def test_create_lowercases(conn): uid = users.create(conn, "New.Person@test.invalid", "New Person") assert users.find_by_email(conn, "new.person@test.invalid")["id"] == uid def test_create_rejects_duplicate_ignoring_case(conn): users.create(conn, "dup@test.invalid", "Dup One") with pytest.raises(ValueError): users.create(conn, "DUP@test.invalid", "Dup Two") def test_create_rejects_duplicate_fixture(conn): with pytest.raises(ValueError): users.create(conn, "GRACE@example.com", "Another Grace") def test_count_includes_fixtures(conn): assert users.count(conn) >= 8

.PHONY: setup dev prepare test

setup:
	python3 scripts/generate_config.py
	python3 scripts/migrate.py
	python3 scripts/reset_fixtures.py

dev:
	pip install -v -e .

prepare:
	python3 scripts/prepare.py

test:
	pytest
